title: A share's exchange frame, peer-share-frame/1 (DEC-0142)
description: One frame of the exchange that confirms a person-to-person share (DEC-0142, docs/specification/peer-share.md): the recipient's claim (its share keys, the claim MAC under the link's code and its commitment), the sender's commit (its share keys and commitment), a side's reveal, or an abort. Both sides commit before either reveals; the comparison code is derived from both reveals (peerComparisonCode). The mailbox checks no claim MAC and opens nothing; it runs peerExchangeVerdict over a share's frames until the first envelope is stored (PS-6, PS-10).

mac.description: HMAC-SHA-256 keyed with the link's code over the RFC 8785 form of {type: fabric-peer-claim/1, shareId, keys, fpr} (claimMac): a filter for the link's holder, checked by the sender's node, never authentication against the mailbox.

nonce.description: 32 random bytes, unpadded base64url, sent only after the side holds the other's commitment.

shareId.description: The share's id: 16 random bytes the sender draws, as 32 lower-case hex digits; never derived from a name, a path or an id of either estate.

jwk.description: A P-256 public key as a JWK (RFC 7517), named elsewhere by its RFC 7638 SHA-256 thumbprint; the point must be on the curve (peerJwk).

sig.description: The side's share signing key (ES256), made for this share only.

kem.description: The side's share key-agreement key (HPKE DHKEM P-256), made for this share only.

keys.description: A side's key pair for one share, never its device keys (DEC-0142 PS-2); two different keys.
